title: Preverbs be- and újra- in Social Integration and Starting Anew

sections.title: Internal Integration with be-
sections.content: The preverb be- denotes movement into an interior space, but in sociological and psychological Hungarian it marks integration into a social collective or institutional structure. Beilleszkedik (to integrate into a group or culture), beleszokik (to get accustomed to a novel environment), and betagozódik (to become incorporated into a system) describe the gradual acculturation process of migrants.

sections.title: Repetition and Renewal with újra-
sections.content: The preverb újra- conveys starting a process again from the foundation up. Újrakezdi az életét (restarts his life), újjáépíti a karrierjét (rebuilds his career), and újraszervezi a közösséget (reorganizes the community) are hallmark B2 collocations when narrating immigrant biographies and overcoming historic traumas.

sections.title: Integration and Renewal Compounds
rows: A menekültek hamar beilleszkedtek az új munkahelyükön.
The refugees soon integrated into their new workplaces.
Nehéz volt beleszokni az angolszász egyetemi rendszerbe.
It was difficult to get accustomed to the Anglo-Saxon university system.
Mindent elveszítettek, mégis képesek voltak újrakezdeni.
They lost everything, yet they were capable of starting anew.

items.spanish: A mérnökök néhány év alatt sikeresen beilleszkedtek a kanadai iparba.
items.english: Within a few years, the engineers successfully integrated into Canadian industry.

items.spanish: A forradalom leverése után sokaknak idegenben kellett újrakezdeniük hivatásukat.
items.english: Following the crushing of the revolution, many had to restart their professions in foreign lands.

items.spanish: Nem volt könnyű beilleszkedni egy olyan országban, amelynek nyelvét nem beszélték.
items.english: It was not easy to integrate into a country whose language they did not speak.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Use beilleszkedik with the allative case (-ba/-be or -hoz/-hez/-höz): beilleszkedik a társadalomba (integrates into society), but beleszokik takes -ba/-be: beleszokik az új életrendbe (gets used to the new lifestyle).
